title: Usage metrics API adds usage from tools like OpenCode
author: Allison
description: The Copilot usage metrics API now reports model usage from more of the tools your developers use with Copilot, including tools like OpenCode that weren’t previously captured in your reports.… The post Usage metrics API adds usage from tools like OpenCode appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
summary: The Copilot usage metrics API now reports model usage from more of the tools your developers use with Copilot, including tools like OpenCode that weren’t previously captured in your reports. A new totals_by_client array is available in the enterprise, organization, enterprise-user, and organization-user 1-day and 28-day reports.
takeaways: This is different from agent app activity , which counts jobs started by agent apps such as Claude and Codex on GitHub. totals_by_client measures model traffic, meaning requests and tokens, from any tool that uses Copilot.

What’s new Each totals_by_client entry represents one client and includes: client : The tool that sent the requests, such as opencode , claude_code , codex , zed , copilot_cli , github_app , cloud_agent , code_review , vscode , or jetbrains .
Copilot code review and Copilot cloud agent: Requests from these clients report product_selected because the product chooses the model.
